encoding.scalars: 32-byte big-endian lowercase hex, must be < L (non-canonical values are rejected)
encoding.challenge: SHA-512( utf8(domain) || for each part: u32be(len) || part ) read as little-endian integer, reduced mod L
encoding.transcriptContext: canonical JSON (keys sorted recursively, no whitespace) of {v: "veilops-range-v1", ...publicInputs}; lower proof uses ctx + "|lower", upper proof uses ctx + "|upper" against D = maxAmount*G - C
encoding.bitProofChallenge: challenge("VEILOPS/range/bit-or/v1", ctx, utf8(decimal index), C_i, A_0, A_1) with A_b = s_b*H - c_b*(C_i - b*G); accept iff c_0 + c_1 = e (mod L) and sum(2^i * C_i) = C
encoding.attestation: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) over utf8("VEILOPS/record/v1|" + canonicalJson(record without attestation))
encoding.recordProof: base64 of utf8 JSON of the policy proof

rangeProofs.description: valid baseline for the negative cases below
invalid: proof checked against a different commitment
invalid: response scalar s0 of bit 1 modified
invalid: challenge share c1 of bit 0 modified
invalid: non-canonical scalar (s1 + L) must be rejected
invalid: bit commitment is not a valid ristretto255 encoding
invalid: declared n does not match number of bit proofs
invalid: value 16 does not fit in 4 bits (top bit dropped)

policyProofs.description: invalid: lower and upper proofs swapped

records.description: valid: proof, proof id and operator signature all check
invalid: commitment swapped (proof and signature both fail)
invalid: recipient edited after signing (signature fails, proof still valid)
invalid: operator re-signed a lower limit; signature is valid but the proof is not
